mapper.select:
select t1.user_id, t1.username, t1.name, t1.email, t1.mobile, t1.status, t1.gmt_create, t1.gmt_modified, (select group_concat(t3.role_name) from sys_user_role t2 inner join sys_role t3 on t2.role_id = t3.role_id where t2.user_id = t1.user_id) as roleNames from sys_user t1
and t1.status = #{status}
and (t1.username like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or t1.name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or t1.email like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or t1.mobile like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
order by t1.user_id desc
select role_id from sys_user_role where user_id = #{userId}

select role_id, role_name, role_sign, remark, gmt_create, gmt_modified from sys_role
and (role_name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or role_sign like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
order by role_id asc
select count(*) from sys_user_role where role_id = #{roleId}
select menu_id from sys_role_menu where role_id = #{roleId}

select t1.menu_id, t1.parent_id, t1.name, t1.url, t1.perms, t1.type, t1.icon, t1.order_num, t1.gmt_create, t1.gmt_modified, t2.name as parentName from sys_menu t1 left join sys_menu t2 on t1.parent_id = t2.menu_id
and (t1.name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or t1.perms like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
order by t1.parent_id asc, t1.order_num asc, t1.menu_id asc
select count(*) from sys_menu where parent_id = #{menuId}
select user_id, username, name, password, email, mobile, status, gmt_create, gmt_modified from sys_user where username = #{username} and status = 1 limit 1
select distinct t3.role_sign from sys_user_role t1 inner join sys_role t3 on t1.role_id = t3.role_id where t1.user_id = #{userId} and t3.role_sign is not null

select distinct t4.perms from sys_user_role t1 inner join sys_role_menu t2 on t1.role_id = t2.role_id inner join sys_menu t4 on t2.menu_id = t4.menu_id where t1.user_id = #{userId} and t4.perms is not null and t4.perms != ''

select distinct t2.menu_id from sys_user_role t1 inner join sys_role_menu t2 on t1.role_id = t2.role_id inner join sys_menu t4 on t2.menu_id = t4.menu_id where t1.user_id = #{userId} and t4.type in (0, 1)
